title: Agent activity ingest v1: what the server accepts
description: The HTTP 200 body of GET /api/v1/agent-activity/ingest. A server that does not answer it (404) does not take activity: send none. Clients ignore properties they do not know.

versions.description: Contract versions the server accepts in the batch's 'schema', newest first.

max_age_days.description: Oldest usage_date accepted, in days before today (UTC).

rate_limit.description: Batches one account may send per window; null when the server does not limit them.

server_time.description: The server's clock, to compare with the client's.

levels.description: The record levels the server accepts.

categories.description: The category keys of categories and timeline.

limits.description: Most items per array property of a record.

optional_fields.description: Record properties added within v1 that the server accepts; send them only when listed. Empty in the first revision.
